The main level flows from the living room through the dining area into an open kitchen with a breakfast nook, and the deck sits right there, contiguous to it, which makes the whole level feel connected to the outside in a way that's pretty rare for a San Francisco Victorian. The lower level has a versatile en-suite bonus room that works as a home office, guest room, or gym, along with a dedicated laundry area, storage, and a 1-car garage.
